description: This file defines the AuditTrailOptionsDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of AuditTrailIndexOptions in the OrchardCore CMS, including rendering views and mapping filter options.

classes.name: AuditTrailOptionsDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for AuditTrailIndexOptions, handling display and editing UI components.

methods.name: BuildPrefix
methods.description: Sets the prefix for options to 'Options' for binding compatibility.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Renders various filter views for the audit trail options.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Prepares the model for editing by mapping current filter results to the model.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates the filter result from form input and proceeds to edit view.

methods.name: BuildUserOptionsViewModel
methods.description: Copies properties from the main model to a view model for UI display.
